contextual.headline: Your recent activity dip interrupts a longer-term improvement.
contextual.explanation: The last four weeks moved against the direction seen across reliable years of your history.
contextual.comparison: Compared with both the previous four weeks and the multi-year direction.
contextual.evidence: Moderate evidence based on your own comparable history.
contextual.action: Respond to the recent shift without discarding the routine behind your longer-term progress.
contextual.restraint: It is too early to call the recent shift a lasting reversal.

contextual.headline: Several activity signals agree: your recent routine has expanded.
contextual.explanation: Steps, distance, and energy form one consistent four-week pattern rather than an isolated metric change.
contextual.comparison: Compared with the four weeks immediately before it.
contextual.evidence: Strong evidence based on your own comparable history.
contextual.action: Keep the activity expansion repeatable and protect recovery around it.
contextual.restraint: Aligned activity signals still do not define your overall recovery.

contextual.headline: Your recent routine is among the most consistent periods in your history.
contextual.explanation: The last three months show less day-to-day variation than most comparable periods, without a clear drop in the underlying level.
contextual.comparison: Compared with rolling three-month periods across your own history.
contextual.evidence: Strong evidence based on your own comparable history.
contextual.action: Preserve the repeatable routine that is supporting this stable period.
contextual.restraint: A stable period does not mean every day should look the same.

contextual.headline: Your recovery tends to respond to sustained sleep, not one exceptional night.
contextual.explanation: Repeated weekly patterns show that better-supported sleep was often followed by a more supportive recovery signal.
contextual.comparison: Seen repeatedly across weekly patterns after removing slow background drift.
contextual.evidence: Moderate evidence based on your own comparable history.
contextual.action: Give sleep a consistent place across the week and watch the following recovery pattern.
contextual.restraint: This repeated association does not prove that one signal caused the other.

contextual.headline: Your long-term story is mixed—and that is the useful part.
contextual.explanation: One important signal became less supportive while another improved, so your history does not reduce to one up-or-down score.
contextual.comparison: Compared across the earliest and latest reliable yearly periods.
contextual.evidence: Moderate evidence based on your own comparable history.
contextual.action: Support the weaker pattern while preserving what has improved.
contextual.restraint: Do not collapse changes moving in different directions into one score.

contextual.headline: Your history does not support a strong personal pattern yet.
contextual.explanation: More comparable days are needed before one change or relationship deserves the primary position.
contextual.comparison: There is no sufficiently reliable personal comparison yet.
contextual.evidence: Insufficient evidence based on your own comparable history.
contextual.action: Keep your routine steady while more comparable evidence forms.
contextual.restraint: Do not turn missing or uneven data into a personal conclusion.

contextual.headline: Sua recuperação tende a responder ao sono sustentado, não a uma única noite excepcional.
contextual.explanation: Padrões semanais repetidos mostram que um sono mais bem sustentado foi frequentemente seguido por um sinal de recuperação mais favorável.
contextual.comparison: Observado repetidamente em padrões semanais após remover a tendência lenta de fundo.
contextual.evidence: Evidência moderada com base no seu próprio histórico comparável.
contextual.action: Dê ao sono um lugar consistente ao longo da semana e observe o padrão de recuperação seguinte.
contextual.restraint: Essa associação repetida não prova que um sinal causou o outro.
